en: So, you've made it all the way up here. You must be quite a Trainer.
We took this tower to tell the world Team Rocket is back. When he hears it, our leader Giovanni will come home from his training.
Team Rocket will be great again, and I won't let a child stand in our way!
How can this be? Everything we dreamed of, gone... I wasn't equal to it after all.
As Giovanni did before me, I'm breaking up Team Rocket, here and now. Farewell.
You've beaten them already? Thank you! You've saved every Pokémon in the country. Here, you more than deserve this.
A tower stood on this very spot long ago. When it came down to make way for the Radio Tower, that feather was found at its top.
A friend of mine in Cianwood City tells me that whoever holds a Rainbow Wing may climb the Bell Tower in Ecruteak City.
Well, I must get back to my office.
Oh, I almost forgot! My friend says the legendary Pokémon won't come just for the wing. There's something else you need...
Now what was it? I can't for the life of me remember.
Waiting for something more, were you? That was a feint! Now I really must go. Goodbye!
Know your place, child. Team Rocket's return can't be stopped.
